'''Pagetti Rook''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Skiff/Legends|skiff]] [[Skiff guard/Legends|guard]] in the [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|service]] of [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Rook was tasked with sending the captive [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] to his [[Death/Legends|death]] in the maw of the [[Sarlacc/Legends|Sarlacc]], only to be killed by the young [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in the [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon]].

==Biography==
By [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> Pagetti Rook<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|143|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: Jabba's Henchmen!}}</ref> had entered the [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|employ]] of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]],<ref name="Jabba">{{CSWECite|II|130|Jabba the Hutt (Jabba Desilijic Tiure)}}</ref> serving as a [[Skiff/Legends|skiff]] [[Skiff guard/Legends|guard]]<ref name="RotJ" /> and an enforcer alongside [[Unidentified Weequay Skiff Master|another]] of his tribe, both of whom were known to others only as "[[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]]," and were responsible for many atrocities during their time in Jabba's service, including a spree of [[Bantha/Legends|bantha]] killings.<ref name="GG5" />

In accordance with the religious practices of their [[Species/Legends|species]], the Weequays captured and sacrificed the beasts as part of religious battle ceremonies, drawing the ire of the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]]<ref name="CCG" /> who cherished them as mounts. With their suspicion over the deaths threatening to unify the usually divided and solitary Tusken for a holy war, Jabba put a stop to the rituals, framing and killing a [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmer]] to take the fall.<ref name="GG5" />

In 4 ABY,<ref name="Date" /> Rook<ref name="Insider" /> acted as lead lookout<ref name="RotJjn">[[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi (junior novelization)|''Star Wars'' Episode VI: ''Return of the Jedi'' junior novelization]]</ref> at the front of the [[Bantha-II cargo skiff/Legends|skiff]] carrying the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] captives [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]. Guarding Jabba's prisoners as they were brought to be fed to the [[Sarlacc/Legends|sarlacc]] inhabiting the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Pit of Carkoon]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], the skiff guard forced Skywalker to the end of the skiff's plank at the Hutt's direction. As the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] leapt down, grabbed the plank, and sprung back onto the skiff's deck, the guard ducked to avoid a stroke of his [[Luke Skywalker's green lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]],<ref name="RotJ" /> before being [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Skywalker during the ensuing [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon|battle]].<ref name="GG5" />

==Personality and traits==
A Weequay [[Gender/Legends|male]],<ref name="GG5" /> Pagetti Rook<ref name="Insider" /> measured 1.7 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in height and had [[Leather/Legends|leathery]] [[Color/Legends|brown]] skin, black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and black [[Hair/Legends|hair]],<ref name="Hasbro" /> worn in a ceremonial topknot of which he was very proud.<ref name="GG5" />

An adherent to the religious ceremonies of the Weequay species<ref name="CCG" /> and one of the most feared of Jabba the Hutt's enforcers, he was a violent individual who spoke little, including to his tribemate, with whom he maintained a close relationship and a remarkable degree of cooperation in combat.<ref name="GG5" />

==Equipment==
Rook<ref name="Insider" /> wore brown fabric torso [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and bracers over a pale blue [[shirt]], tan pants, and brown boots.<ref name="RotJ" /> He wielded a [[BD-1 Cutter vibro-ax/Legends|force pike]] as his preferred weapon, though he also employed an [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11 blaster rifle]].<ref name="Hasbro" />

==Behind the scenes==
''[[Star Wars: The Action Figure Archive]]'' first provided the nickname Queequeg for this character; however, this was only a production nickname. [[Leland Chee]] still referred to this character as "Weequay hunter"<ref name="Chee">{{Blog|holocron|27/comments|Jabba's Skiff Guards}}</ref> and later named him Pagetti Rook in [[Star Wars Insider 143|''Star Wars Insider'' 143]].<ref name="Insider" />

[[Wikipedia:Queequeg|Queequeg]] is a fictional Polynesian harpononer from [[Wikipedia:Herman Melville|Herman Melville's]] 1851 novel [[Wikipedia:Moby-Dick|''Moby-Dick'']]. The Weequay species were named after the Polynesian Queequeg<ref name="Databank">{{DB|species|weequay|Weequay}}</ref> but were originally named ''Queequay'' by the crew of ''Return of the Jedi''.<ref name="I67">{{InsiderCite|67|Set Piece|Set Piece: Jabba's Sail Barge}}</ref>
